example:
import { AgentBadge, Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@godxjp/ui/data-display";
import { Text } from "@godxjp/ui/general";
import { Flex } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<Flex align="center" gap="sm">
  <Avatar kind="agent">
    <AvatarImage src={agent.avatarUrl} alt="" />
    <AvatarFallback>ハ</AvatarFallback>
  </Avatar>
  <Text>ハルカ</Text>
  <AgentBadge />
</Flex>
name: AgentBadge

props.description: Render element. `span` (default) because the label sits in a name's text line, often inside a link or a <button>.
props.name: as

props.description: Overrides the localized default label (`dataDisplay.avatar.agent`: ja "AIエージェント", en "AI agent", vi "Tác tử AI"). Omit it — the default follows the locale.
props.name: children

props.description: Extra classes on the label root.
props.name: className

related: Avatar — `kind="agent"` puts the "AI" tag on the mark itself; use it everywhere an agent's mark appears, and add AgentBadge where its name is printed.
Badge — the general chip; AgentBadge is a fixed-meaning label built on the same chip geometry.
tagline: The "AI agent" label beside a NAME — violet outline on a transparent ground, pill, never wraps. The text-row half of telling an AI agent apart from a person; `Avatar kind="agent"` is the mark half. A list that shows names uses BOTH; a place with only a mark (assignee icon column, dense cell) uses the Avatar alone.
usage: DO put it right after the agent's name, in the same text line: `<Flex align="center" gap="xs"><Text>{name}</Text><AgentBadge /></Flex>`, and pair it with `<Avatar kind="agent">` on the same row.
DO leave `children` empty so the label follows the locale; it is real text, so it is announced as written and never colour-only (WCAG 1.4.1).

DON'T hand-roll it as `<Badge variant="outline" className="text-violet-600">AI</Badge>` — the colour reads the `--agent` role through `--badge-agent-border` / `--badge-agent-foreground`, which a theme retunes once.
DON'T add it where there is no name (an icon-only column, a 24px cell) — there the Avatar's own AI tag is the marker.
useCases: A member list, a people picker, an assignee dropdown option — any row that prints a principal's name.
A comment, an activity entry or a chat message authored by an AI agent.
